name: entra-node-login-demo
description: Sign in with Microsoft Entra and show the user's oid, name and email

scripts.cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 365 -keyout certs/localhost-key.pem -out certs/localhost.pem -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost'
